cut.text: Kathang-isip ang pamilya ko, ang laro, ang paaralan, si Ma'am, sina Bea at JM.
Kathang-isip din kami nina M at Usman, ang lente at ang kuwaderno.

keep_with_the_word.text: Ma'am, pasensya na po, pero hindi po totoo ang kodigo.
keep_with_the_word.why: History: the Code of Kalantiaw really was a hoax. This is a fact about the real record, spoken as plot dialogue.

keep_with_the_word.text: Pinagtatalunan pa kung si Marco lang ang gumawa, at bakit.
keep_with_the_word.why: A disputed point in the real record. It is now the last line of the fairness beat.

keep_with_the_word.text: May itinuro ba sa'yo sa eskwela na hindi pala totoo?
keep_with_the_word.why: The viewer question at the end. It is about real teaching, not about the story.
